title: Mid-Autumn text lands: Full-Moon Promise replaces the football festival
summary: This version is text only: 322 localization keys are added or rewritten. The festival line is re-themed from football to the Mid-Autumn Full-Moon Promise, and new strings arrive for Auto Rally, a News Center, Ace Trial power advice, Dream Isle furnishings and the Corrupted Meowdame hunt. No palmons, skills, items or systems changed.
highlights: Festival text is rewritten from the football-themed Football Fiesta line to Full-Moon Promise, with names such as Moonlit Scroll, Moonlit Reunion Feast and Moon-Lantern Bounty (71 keys).
Ruins challenge text gains power guidance: Recommended Power, Power Insufficient, and per-system upgrade advice for mounts and core breakthroughs (54 keys).
New Auto Rally strings appear under the gather activity, covering Auto Rally enabled, disabled and duration refreshed.
A News Center is described for the first time, with battle headlines, Server News, View Coordinates and a world-map red dot toggle.
Dream Isle adds furnishing names and descriptions through Moonveil Palace and Moonlit Spring, plus Huzzah, visitor and interaction logs.
The Corrupted Meowdame event is written out: rally Bullypunks for Trail Maps, summon Meowdame with one, and it stays for one hour.
35 team camp info keys are still placeholders reading #N/A.
